description: Open-source, community-driven terminal coding agent for DeepSeek V4 and other models.

next.name: app-server
tip: Run the canonical runtime API / control plane (HTTP/SSE, mobile, stdio).

option.name: --auth-token
tip: Bearer token for runtime API routes.

option.name: --host
tip: Bind host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; with --mobile and no host, binds 0.0.0.0.

option.name: --http
tip: Serve the full HTTP/SSE runtime API (/v1/*).

option.name: --insecure-no-auth
tip: Disable runtime API auth when no token is configured.

option.name: --mobile
tip: Serve the runtime API plus the phone-friendly mobile control page.

option.name: --port
tip: Bind port. Defaults to 7878 for --http/--mobile, 8787 for legacy.

option.name: --qr
tip: Show a QR code for the mobile URL in the terminal (requires --mobile).

option.name: --stdio
tip: Run the app-server JSON-RPC control transport over stdio (no listener).

next.name: apply
tip: Apply a patch file or stdin to the working tree.

next.name: auth
tip: Manage authentication credentials and provider mode.

next.name: clear
tip: Delete a provider's key from config and secret-store storage.

next.name: external-consent
tip: Explicitly allow read-only access to one credential file owned by another CLI.

option.name: --yes
tip: Confirm the disclosed exact read-only grant without an interactive prompt.

next.name: external-revoke
tip: Revoke access to another CLI's credential file for one provider.

next.name: get
tip: Report the effective credential route for a provider. Never prints a credential.

next.name: list
tip: List all known providers with their runtime-effective auth state, without revealing credentials.

next.name: print-api-key
tip: Pipe the runtime-effective API key to a local client; refuses terminals.

next.name: set
tip: Save an API key to the shared user config file.

option.name: --api-key
tip: Inline value (discouraged — appears in shell history).

option.name: --api-key-stdin
tip: Read the key from stdin instead of prompting.

next.name: status
tip: Show current provider and runtime-effective credential route state.

option.name: --provider
tip: Show status for a specific provider only.

next.name: xai-device
tip: Sign in to xAI/Grok with an SSH-friendly device code.

next.name: completions
tip: Generate shell completions for the TUI binary.

next.name: get
tip: Get a config value by key.

next.name: eval
tip: Run the offline TUI evaluation harness.

next.name: exec
tip: Run a non-interactive prompt through the TUI runtime.
E: codewhale exec "explain this function" --- Explain a function
E: codewhale exec --auto "list crates/ with ls" --- Auto-approve tool use
E: codewhale exec --auto --output-format stream-json "fix the failing test" --- Stream JSON output

option.name: --auto
tip: Enable tool-backed agent mode with auto-approvals.

option.name: --continue
tip: Continue the most recent session for this workspace.

option.name: --resume
tip: Resume a previous session by ID or prefix.

option.name: --session-id
tip: Resume a previous session by ID or prefix.

next.name: fleet
tip: Manage durable Agent Fleet runs via the TUI runtime.

next.name: init
tip: Create a default AGENTS.md in the current directory.

next.name: lane
tip: Manage running workflow instances (Lanes) and Runtime backends.

next.name: attach
tip: Attach to a tmux-backed lane (prints attach command; execs when possible).

option.name: --print
tip: Only print the attach command; do not exec.

next.name: interrupt
tip: Interrupt a running lane. Accepts an exact lane id, optionally fenced as <lane-id>@<seq>.

next.name: logs
tip: Tail the lane stream-json / NDJSON journal.

option.name: --tail
tip: Number of trailing lines when not following (default 50).

next.name: restart
tip: Restart a lane in place (declared, no backend — reports why).

next.name: resume
tip: Resume a stopped lane (declared, no backend — reports why).

next.name: start
tip: Start a lane under a Runtime backend (tmux|inline|vm|ci).

option.name: --worktree-repo
tip: Create an isolated worktree under this repo root.

option.name: --worktree-ttl-secs
tip: Worktree cleanup TTL seconds after stop (0 = immediate on stop).

next.name: status
tip: Show one lane's status and attach metadata.

next.name: stop
tip: Stop a running lane and run worktree TTL cleanup. Compatibility spelling for lane interrupt.

next.name: mcp-server
tip: Run MCP server mode over stdio.

next.name: metrics
tip: Print a usage rollup from the audit log and session store.

option.name: --since
tip: Restrict to events newer than this duration (e.g. 7d, 24h, 30m, now-2h).

next.name: model
tip: Resolve or list available models across providers.

next.name: resolve
tip: Resolve a model name to its full identifier.

next.name: set
tip: Set the default model (e.g. pro, flash, deepseek-v4-pro).

next.name: models
tip: List live provider API models via the TUI binary.

next.name: rc
tip: Launch an interactive session and hand it to the Codewhale web app.

next.name: remote-setup
tip: Generate a remote Codewhale agent deploy bundle (cloud + chat bridge).

option.name: --apply
tip: Run the cloud CLI to auto-provision (not yet implemented).

option.name: --bridge
tip: Chat bridge slug. Skips the prompt.

option.name: --cloud
tip: Cloud target slug. Skips the prompt.

option.name: --generate-only
tip: Emit the bundle, do not provision (default).

option.name: --non-interactive
tip: Fail instead of prompting if any required value is missing.

option.name: --provider
tip: Provider slug; validated against the provider registry. Skips the prompt.

option.name: --yes
tip: Skip the final confirmation gate (CI / non-interactive).

next.name: review
tip: Run a Codewhale-powered code review over a git diff.

next.name: run
tip: Run interactive/non-interactive flows via the TUI binary.

next.name: check
tip: Check sandbox policy for a command.

option.name: --acp
tip: Start ACP server over stdio for editor clients.

option.name: --auth-token
tip: Require this bearer token for /v1/* runtime API routes.

option.name: --insecure
tip: Disable runtime API auth when no token is configured.

option.name: --mobile
tip: Start runtime HTTP/SSE API server with the mobile control page.

option.name: --qr
tip: Show a QR code for the mobile URL (requires --mobile).

option.name: --web
tip: Start the embedded loopback-only browser client.

next.name: setup
tip: Bootstrap MCP config and/or skills directories.

next.name: speech
tip: Generate speech audio with Xiaomi MiMo TTS models via the TUI binary.

next.name: thread
tip: Manage thread/session metadata and resume/fork flows.

next.name: clear-name
tip: Remove the custom name from a thread, restoring the default (unnamed) rendering in thread list.

option.name: --limit
tip: Maximum number of threads to show.

next.name: set-name
tip: Set a custom name for a thread.

next.name: update
tip: Check for and apply updates to the codewhale binary.

option.name: --beta
tip: Update to the latest beta release instead of the latest stable release.

option.name: --check
tip: Only check the latest release; do not download or replace binaries.

option.name: --proxy
tip: Proxy URL to use for update HTTP requests.

next.name: web
tip: Open the first-class local browser client over the canonical Runtime API.

option.name: --port
tip: Loopback port for the local Runtime API and embedded client (default: 7878).

next.name: workflow
tip: Run checked-in Workflows through a Lane Runtime backend.

next.name: run
tip: Run a checked-in Workflow through a Runtime-backed Lane.

option.name: --fleet
tip: Named Fleet roster (e.g. stopship). Required for role-resolved Workflow runs.

option.name: --goal
tip: Free-form goal text recorded on the Lane and passed into workflow args.

option.name: --issue
tip: Issue id binding recorded on the Lane and passed into workflow args.

option.name: --source-path
tip: Explicit Workflow source path, overriding name-based resolution.

option.name: --verify
tip: Run verifier gates after a successful Workflow completion.

option.name: --worktree-repo
tip: Create an isolated worktree under this repo root.

option.name: --worktree-ttl-secs
tip: Worktree cleanup TTL seconds after stop (0 = immediate on stop).

option.name: --base-url
tip: Base URL for the provider API.

option.name: --continue
tip: Continue the most recent interactive session for this workspace.

option.name: --no-project-config
tip: Skip loading project-level config, including the workspace-specific overlay from user config. Must appear before the subcommand.

option.name: --prompt
tip: Prompt to pass to the model.

option.name: --provider
tip: Provider selector; exec/fleet also accept configured custom provider identifiers.

option.name: --workspace
tip: Workspace directory for TUI file tools.
